quote: PerceptiveAgent, an empathetic multi-modal dialogue system that can discern deeper or more subtle meanings beyond the literal interpretations of words, based on speaking styles described in natural language. Specifically, PerceptiveAgent first comprehends the speaker's intentions accurately by a perceptive captioner model that captures acoustic features from each speech within dialogues. Subsequently, an LLM module acts as the cognitive core, producing the relevant response content with a caption describing how to articulate the response.

quote: Cognitive and affective empathy are assessed by evaluating the quality of generated textual responses and audio responses, respectively. To evaluate the quality of dialogue text generation, we employ the BERTScore automatic evaluation metric... To evaluate the expressiveness of audio generation, we employ an expressive style classifier proposed by Nguyen et al. ... Classification accuracy is used to measure the performance. ... Weighted metrics including precision, recall and F1-score are used to quantify the disparity between the predicted and true labels. ... For evaluating the preservation of prosody, we compute the F0 Frame Error (FFE).
BERTScore (%) measures the quality of cognitive empathy in linguistic contents, while accuracy (%) assesses the quality of affective empathy in acoustic responses.
